event: Alan moves, the hush falls, and he runs the open bank in total silence.
Tygryth folds the boss into his dark without fire, and takes the wader under the water.
One hauler runs for the trees; the other charges the cage, knife up, at Alan.
Wren works the cage pin free while Alan turns the knife aside and strips it.
A knee to his cut ribs whites his sight, but Alan pins the big man alive.
Tygryth runs down the last hauler; four for four, he lets the hush go.
The cage opens: a starving girl, half-armored in black scales, eyes slit amber.

event: Back on the bank, the girl rises in the cage and warns them off what is hers.
Smitten, Alan bows like a butler over the pinned man: My lady, dinner is served.
She eats the dead slavers, eyes on him the whole time, and asks why he gives it.
Tygryth claims her as newly his, and allows that the bow was very good.
